name: Frontend UX & Explainability
features_added: Improved production result card with prediction, confidence, probability-like score, top signals, and explanation sections.
Confidence visualization with accessible progress bar, percentage text, and green/yellow/red color coding.
Expandable Technical Details section with model version, prediction timestamp, request ID, backend version, and API response time.
Analyze Another Email reset button with focus restoration to subject input.
Improved loading animation with status text and animated progress treatment.
Distinct error treatments for timeout, network failure, backend unavailable, invalid request, and unknown failures.
Retry action retained for failed predictions and duplicate submissions disabled during analysis.

api_metadata.request_id_source: x-request-id response header when exposed by backend/CORS or backend error payload when present
api_metadata.response_time_source: client-side performance measurement around the /predict request

accessibility_checks: Analyze, retry, copy, and reset controls are keyboard reachable native buttons.
Form inputs have labels, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby for validation messages.
Validation and copy failure messages use role=alert where appropriate.
Result aside uses aria-live and aria-busy for screen reader updates.
Loading indicator exposes role=status and an accessible label.
Progress bars include role=progressbar with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow.
Expandable technical details uses native details/summary keyboard behavior.
Color coding is paired with text labels and percentages rather than relying on color alone.
responsive_verification: Desktop: existing two-column dashboard grid preserved for input and result panels.
Tablet: result metric cards wrap with sm:grid-cols-2 while preserving readable spacing.
Mobile: form actions, error actions, and result actions stack vertically; long request IDs break safely.
Build output prerendered /dashboard/analyse successfully, confirming responsive page code compiles in production.
constraints_observed: ML model was not modified or retrained.
Backend prediction logic and backend APIs were not modified.
Authentication and Supabase were not modified.
